content.user_title: Animate Images with RunComfy Video Models
content.value_statement: Different video requests require different models, media inputs, and prompt settings. This skill guides RunComfy model selection and CLI calls for animation, voiceover lip-sync, and combined references.
actual_capabilities: Routes requests to HappyHorse for general animation, Wan for custom voiceovers, or Seedance for combined media references.
Provides model-specific parameter tables and RunComfy CLI invocation examples.
Guides motion, camera, lighting, and preservation prompts for portrait and product animation.
Documents voiceover-driven talking-head generation and language variants through Wan audio inputs.
Explains numbered image, video, and audio references for Seedance composition.
Documents login prerequisites, output downloads, cancellation behavior, and common CLI exit codes.
limitations: Requires an external RunComfy CLI, authenticated account, network access, and accessible media URLs; no local generation engine is included.
Documented routes produce clips up to 15 seconds; Seedance settings here stop at 720p, and HappyHorse preserves the input aspect ratio.
The Wan example uses text-to-video plus audio without a source image input; it does not demonstrate animating an existing portrait.
Selects one model per call; combining outputs requires separate editing, and generation quality or identity preservation is not guaranteed.

use_cases.title: Animate product photography
use_cases.description: Prepare a short product reveal with controlled camera motion and explicit packaging preservation using the HappyHorse route.

use_cases.title: Prepare localized spokesperson clips
use_cases.description: Use approved voiceover tracks with Wan to generate talking-head variants while keeping prompt settings and seeds consistent.

use_cases.title: Combine approved creative references
use_cases.description: Use Seedance to combine a subject image, scene reference video, and audio reference in one short clip.

prompt_templates.title: Animate a portrait
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this portrait URL: [image URL]. Prepare a five-second HappyHorse animation with subtle breathing and a slow camera drift. Preserve facial features. Confirm before submission.

prompt_templates.title: Create a product reveal
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [product image URL] for a six-second HappyHorse reveal. Choose one gentle orbit and preserve packaging text and geometry. Confirm settings before submission.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: control motion and product consistency.

prompt_templates.title: Generate voiceover variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare Wan talking-head requests for [approved voiceover URLs]. Use a vertical frame, one shared prompt, and one seed. Match durations within supported limits. Confirm before submission.

prompt_templates.title: Compose multiple references
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an eight-second Seedance request using [subject image URL], [scene video URL], and [audio URL]. Assign each reference explicitly. Validate media limits. Confirm before submission.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine image, video, and audio references.

output_examples.input: Combine my subject image, cafe reference video, and approved voice reference into an eight-second clip.
output: Reference roles: subject from image 1, scene from video 1, and voice tone from audio 1.
Pending checks: reference formats, durations, audio size, media rights, and approval before remote submission.

best_practices: Use approved media and confirm remote processing before submitting sensitive images, voices, or reference clips.
Choose one primary motion, state preservation goals, and keep reference styles compatible.
Check model-specific media limits, duration, resolution, and output location before submitting a generation request.
anti_patterns: Using the Wan text-to-video example when the requirement is to animate an existing portrait image.
Combining incompatible reference styles or several competing camera movements in one short clip.
Assuming this skill blends multiple model outputs or guarantees exact identity, lip-sync, and text preservation.

faq.question: What must I install before using this skill?
faq.answer: Install the RunComfy CLI and authenticate with a RunComfy account. The documentation also describes token-based authentication for CI.

faq.question: How does the skill choose a model?
faq.answer: It uses a routing table: HappyHorse for general animation, Wan for supplied voiceovers, and Seedance for combined image, video, and audio references.

faq.question: Does the Wan route animate my existing portrait?
faq.answer: The documented Wan route accepts a prompt and audio, not a portrait input. Use HappyHorse for the demonstrated still-image animation workflow.

faq.question: What clip lengths and resolutions are documented?
faq.answer: All three routes have a 15-second maximum. HappyHorse and Wan list up to 1080p; Seedance lists up to 720p.

faq.question: Are my media inputs processed locally?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow submits requests to RunComfy, whose model servers fetch media URLs. Review provider privacy terms before sending sensitive content.

faq.question: Can I combine outputs from different models automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill selects one model per call. Combining separately generated clips requires an editing workflow outside this skill.
